scope: Twenty-plus deterministic RoboTwin adjust_bottle reset inventory
summary: Parallel physical-A800 reset screening produced 21 independently reproducible, scene-changing adjust_bottle seeds, passing the frozen minimum-20 reset gate before expert trajectory collection.
evidence: Every accepted seed has two new setup runs with qpos/endpose/bottle maximum error 0, exact head-RGB hash, and equal model/qpose tags.
Every accepted record also includes a different stable seed whose scene changes by bottle pose, model ID, qpose tag, or RGB.
The summary covers 33 result artifacts; 12 blocked results, including unstable object seeds, remain preserved.
The frozen gate requires 20 stable seeds and reports 21, so gate_passed=true.
lessons: RoboTwin's nominal seed range includes unstable object initializations; stability must be measured and invalid seeds retained rather than silently retried.
Four-way GPU screening can establish reset reproducibility independently of the still-blocked expert planner.
limitations: The reset workers intentionally stub point-cloud/save modules and motion planners; they do not execute expert actions.
No A+ or A_swap rollout has yet been collected for these seeds.
next_actions: Use the 21 frozen seeds for official Curobo expert collection, then retain the first 20 successful A+ seeds for paired replay.
